newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Bang places 40 mln shrs at HK$1 each.
newsitem.headline: Dah Bang places 40 mln shrs at HK$1 each.

text.p: Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd said it would issue 40 million new shares to controlling shareholder Golik Investments Ltd at HK$1.00 each after a placement of 35 million shares by Golik at the same price to private investors.
The new issue would raise about HK$38.5 million, after expenses, and the money would be used for general working capital, Dah Bang said in a statement.
After the share issue and placement, Golik's interest in Dah Bang, the printing machinery distributor, will be lowered to 50.3 percent from 57.86 percent.
Dah Bang shares ended at HK$1.02 per share on Wednesday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
